The '''Tao-Ni Security Compound''' was a bunker located on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. Situated in the [[Desert of Salma/Legends|Salma Desert]], it was used as a base of operations for the [[Tao-Ni Security]] organization. The compound was guarded by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, as well as [[Tao-Ni Security Mechanized Alpha Class|Alpha]] and [[Tao-Ni Security Mechanized Omega Class|Omega Class]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].
[[File:Tao-NiSecurityCompound2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Another view of the compound]]

==Behind the scenes==
The Tao-Ni Security Compound was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Tao-Ni Security Compound was added to the game along with the "[[W:c:swg:IG-88|IG-88]] heroic encounter", released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]]" update on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
